about: Control sets of the reference app's effects, for the Classic pack. Facts read from saved XML on the development machine (reference app 7.26.0; bundled presets saved by 7.3.0; user compositions). No code, shader or preset file was copied. See .scratch/v1/issues/46-classic-effect-pack.md.

conventions.order: parameter order as saved; for complete effects this is the full control list
conventions.name: the parameter's name in XML, which the preset importer matches
conventions.label: the XML altName when present, else the name; the UI label is confirmed by REST in phase 2
conventions.id: our parameter id: name in camelCase (words split at non-alphanumerics; an all-caps first word lowercased)
conventions.stored: the value domain in saved files ([0, 1] for plugin-style effects whose values are normalized)
conventions.display: REST ParameterView of the reference app (7.26.0): min/max of the REST value, multiplier, suffix, units, control, step, altName (the UI label), choice options, and response: the displayed value (REST value x multiplier) read back after setting 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and 1 of the range. REST values are linear in the stored domain for every control; a step quantises the control in the UI
conventions.coverage: complete: a bundled preset saves every parameter; partial: only non-default values seen in compositions; none: never saved
conventions.wrapper: every effect sits in a dry/wet wrapper with Opacity (default 1, our `mix`) and a Blend Mode mixer (default Alpha 67464115; Add is 67464114)
conventions.controls: complete: REST lists every control of the effect, in UI order (wrapper Opacity and Blend Mode excluded)
conventions.mixer: measured: the Add mixer crossfades additively, dry x min(1, 2 - 2 x Opacity) + wet x min(1, 2 x Opacity); Alpha mixes dry and wet by Opacity
conventions.measured: phase 6 reference captures (UV picture, test card, semi-transparent flat colour, marker clip): what each control does in real units; one control at a time from the defaults unless stated

choice.encoding: round(value * 6): 7 positions, the UI steps by 1/6
options: inverted: the picture outside the strips
strips show the picture turned with them, magnified 3x across and 2x along around its centre; overlaps add
as 3, around a random place across per strip
strips show the picture colour-inverted, the picture outside
the picture outside; strips lay its channels as (green, blue, green) over it
choice.source: measured over REST snapshots; bundled presets use 0, 0.467 (3), 0.701 (4) and 0.842 (5)

choice.encoding: round(value * 2): 3 positions, the UI steps by 1/2
choice.source: measured over REST snapshots; bundled presets use 0 and 0.773 (1)

measured.strips: floor(Number * 10), each at a random centre in [-1, 1] of composition UV from the centre, new per effect instance; a higher Number adds strips without moving the others
measured.width: 3 x GlobalWidth x a random share between MinWidth and MaxWidth, in UV along the strip axis
measured.direction: whole turns in UV space (0 vertical strips, 0.25 horizontal), so a turn follows the aspect
measured.speed: strips slide and wrap over [-1, 1]: 0.12, 0.23 and 0.65 UV/s at Speed 0.01, 0.02 and 0.04 (about 11.5 per unit at low speeds, faster than linear above); higher speeds alias in snapshots
measured.layout: random per instance, so frames are compared by the share of the picture left as it was

measured.luma: weighted: 0.3594 R + 0.4010 G + 0.2396 B of the sRGB values; unweighted: the HSL lightness (max + min) / 2
measured.contrast: a gain of 5 x Contrast on that luminance (neutral at 0.2)
measured.palette: Mode Palette maps the luminance onto black, red, green, yellow, 50 % grey, blue, magenta, cyan, white at equal steps
measured.greysKeep: unmeasured beyond the test card: its greys keep their colour and its bars do not

measured.Mode: 0 and 1 both draw edges on black; 0 is about half as bright on the test card
measured.Multiplier: edge gain: 0 is black, the test card's hard edges saturate from about 0.25
measured.Use Color / Color: edges take the colour (colour alpha 0.5 halves them)
measured.Amount: no visible change in any captured case (0..1 on all three inputs)
measured.alpha: output alpha is the input alpha

measured.Amount: 0 leaves the picture unchanged, rising to the full glow at 1
measured.Threshold: 0 and 0.125 turn the whole picture white (alpha 1); above, only the bright parts glow
measured.Size / Gaussian: 0 is nearly unchanged (MAE 2.6 on the test card); both widen the glow

measured.Feedback: 1 freezes the picture (every snapshot identical); 0 shows the clip as it is; between, a decaying smear of the moving shapes
measured.Mode: Alpha and Luma smear darker over dark ground; Lighten keeps the brightest (the smear stays bright)

measured.mapping: source u = frac(Parts x angle + 0.75 - Angle), angle in turns from +x counter-clockwise with y up; source v = frac(radius / 960 px x (Rings + 1) / 2)
measured.Angle: turns (0.25 shifts the source u by -0.25)

measured.mapping: each quadrant shows the whole picture at half size: top-left as it is, top-right mirrored in x, bottom-left in y, bottom-right both
measured.Flip X / Flip Y: mirror every quadrant in that axis

measured.Frequency: flash period 2 x (1 - Frequency) seconds at any tempo (1 s at 0.5, 0.5 s at 0.75, 0.25 s at 0.875, the same at 120 and 90 BPM); 0 never flashes, 1 stays on; on half of each period
measured.Fade: the flash ramps up and down linearly over the period (a triangle) instead of switching
measured.Color: the flash replaces the picture with the colour at its alpha (white at 0.5 gives grey 128)

measured.Frequency: how often the pattern changes, not whether it shows: every 1 - Frequency seconds at any tempo (1.0, 0.5, 0.25 s at 0, 0.5, 0.75, the same at 120 and 90 BPM), every snapshot (13/s or more) at 1
measured.Horizontal / Vertical / Size: amount of shifted area: Horizontal 0 (with Vertical 0) or Size 0 shows the picture unchanged; the shifted share grows with each
measured.random: a new random pattern per instance and per change

measured.Brightness: adds Brightness x 255 levels to R, G and B (clipped); display -100..100 %
measured.Contrast: scales the colour about black: gain 1 + Contrast below 0, 1 + 5 x Contrast above (0 at -1, 6 at 1)

measured.Base: adds 4 x (Base - 0.5) (black at 0.25 and below, white at 0.75 and above)
measured.Midpoint: gamma: out = in ^ (2 x (1 - Midpoint)); 0.5 identity

measured.Threshold: Rec. 601 luma of the colour against Threshold: above gives Color 1, below Color 2
measured.Smoothness: widens the step into a ramp around the threshold (at 1 the ramp spans 94..161 over input 0..255)
measured.Alpha: Replace makes alpha 1; Original and Combine keep the input alpha with opaque colours

measured.Hue Scale: multiplies the hue (1 identity, 0 turns every hue red)
measured.Sat. Scale: HSL saturation x 2 x Sat. Scale (0 grey at the HSL lightness, 0.5 identity)
